practices.name: Ease through the body with the breath (Trika prep)
practices.howto: Sit upright and let the breath settle into a comfortable rhythm. Notice where the breath is clearest and rest attention there. Let that sense of ease spread through the whole body, using the breath as a home base for steady attention. When the mind wanders, return gently to the breath without force. Close by sitting quietly for a few breaths and noticing the whole body at once.
practices.source_note: Thanissaro Bhikkhu breath method (free, publisher site); used here as the Trika-prep foundation for steady attention before gap and recognition work.
contraindications: Keep the breath natural; never hold it or force it.
If you feel disoriented, unreal or anxious, open the eyes, feel the feet and the seat, and stop for today.
This week is a foundation only. Initiated Trika practice (mantra, breath retention, subtle-body work) is learned from a qualified teacher in the tradition.
